correctness.rationale: Evaluation at p distinct points is injective since deg f<=k<p. Vieta characterizes exactly k distinct roots by root sum s=-eta^-1, and each qualifying k-set produces precisely p-1 scalar words. For a word with at most k zeros, cyclic runs give at most k-b+1 all-zero windows for 2<=b<=k, equality precisely for a single k-run. A Vandermonde rank-(k-1) evaluation minor constructs words with k-1 consecutive zeros, completing both distance branches. Arithmetic orders have k-window sums with nonzero slope dk, so N=1. The specified adjacent swap changes exactly two k-window sums by +1,-1; the second would remain s only if k^2=1 mod p, excluded for 2<=k<=p-2. For k=p-1, complements of one coordinate give each sum exactly once. Independently enumerated all messages and b-windows in five full-field examples, including k=p-1. Finite tests are corroboration.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification corroborates but cannot establish the all-parameter proof.
